Jin: FYI opened a small docs PR to harmonize streaming pagination examples across py/ts/go and add a short migration blurb about resumable cursors: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/701
Mira: nice. can we demonstrate both generator and callback styles for TS? and avoid blocking sleeps in py examples.
Sam: agree. also call out cursor TTL and how to detect ExpiredCursor so integrators don't try to resume forever.
Jin: added a concise python snippet using our async retry helper:
```python
# async stream + non-blocking resume
async for page in client.responses.stream_paginate(prompt):
    for tok in page.tokens:
        handle(tok)
    if page.transient_error:
        await retry_with_jitter(lambda: client.responses.resume(page.cursor))
```
Owen: CI flagged a gofmt issue and an unused import in the Go sample. I'll patch and run gofmt.
Mira: for TS I added both the `for await` generator and a short event-emitter example. left a tiny comment to add types so editors show completions.
Sam: posted a suggestion to the migration note to prefer the phrase "resumable cursor" for consistency.
Link-bot: link-checker: 2/2 links OK. docs-lint: minor line-length warning in examples.go (Owen to fix).
Owen: pushed go fix (replaced unused import, applied gofmt). CI green now.
Jin: thanks all. I'll backport this docs-only change to release/v1.8 and add a changelog line: "docs: unify streaming pagination examples across SDKs".
Mira: LGTM, approving. I'll announce in #integrations once merged.
Sam: can we follow up with a small e2e example in examples repo showing reconnects? filing an issue to track it.
Jin: filed issue #783. Thanks team!
